$comment: Per-part corrections, for the parts that disagree with their family.
Two kinds, and they fail in different ways. `h`/`w` correct a filename
that disagrees with its model: every one was found by
packages/indexer/src/audit.ts and confirmed in two dimensions — the
measured height matches one unit count *and* the measured width
independently matches another. A height that merely looks wrong is not
enough, because a bbox can legitimately exceed the mounting plate — see
`turnZDeg` corrects a model drawn a quarter or a half turn round from
the rest of its family, in degrees anticlockwise seen from in front and
above. The name is right and the mesh is turned, which is the opposite
fault. A quarter turn shows up in the audit the same way a transposed
name does, so it meets the same two-dimension bar; a half turn does not
move a bounding box at all and has to be seen, so those entries say what
Thirteen of 541 parts, all in the community-contributed Tool_hooks. The
seventeen curated families audit clean, which is the strongest evidence
yet that the parametric model holds.

parts.name: 6x4 RD6006P_Power_Supply
parts.reason: both wrong: measures 101.4 tall (h=4) and 183.2 wide (w=7)

parts.name: 3x1 Halder Secural
parts.reason: both wrong: measures 50.6 tall (h=2) and 81.6 wide (w=3)

parts.name: 1x3 Dewalt DCV501 Stick Vacuum
parts.reason: measures 50.6 tall (h=2); the width of 73.8 already agrees with w=3

parts.name: 2x3 6x 6mm Finger Slots
parts.reason: measures 25.2 tall (h=1); the width of 81.6 already agrees with w=3

parts.name: 2x6 12x 6mm Finger Slots
parts.reason: measures 25.2 tall (h=1); the width of 157.8 already agrees with w=6

parts.name: 2x5 Irwin Pliers LgLock Linemans
parts.reason: drawn a quarter turn clockwise of its family: measures 50.6 across print X (h=2) and 132.4 along print Y (w=5), which is both of its named dimensions in the wrong axes. Turned back, its profile is the same rising ramp as the three Irwin racks beside it

parts.name: 4x4 Large Pliers Rack
parts.reason: drawn back to front: the slots the pliers drop into open toward the panel, and the tall closed face stands out in the room. A half turn leaves the bbox alone, so this was found by looking at the mesh from behind the wall rather than by the audit

parts.name: 4x6 Medium Pliers Rack
parts.reason: drawn back to front, the same way round as the Large Pliers Rack and confirmed the same way: its six slots open toward the panel instead of into the room

notCorrected.name: 8x2.25 LiitoKala Charger
notCorrected.reason: Width 208.6 agrees with w=8, but the height of 57.0 fits no whole unit count - the nearest, h=2, is 6.4 mm out. Its name is probably height x width reversed with a fractional height, which the grid has no way to express. Left alone rather than guessed at.

notCorrected.name: 1x6 11pc Wrench Hanger
notCorrected.reason: Measures 159.1 tall against 25.2 for h=1, and Tool_hooks/README.md says to print it with 6x0 Flats. But the excess is the eleven downward hooks, not a wrong name - the bounding box exceeds the mounting plate. That is the `perPart` problem, not an override.
